faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) for filling up vacant positions on a direct recruitment basis across India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the position of Assistant Manager/ Operations under the Operations department of NCRTC.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Manager/ Operations position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-Time Engineering Graduate degree along with required post-qualification experience in systems operations, maintenance, IoT, electronics, and related domains.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwBD as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary scale for Assistant Manager/ Operations?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process close?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 23 October 2026. Candidates must submit their online and offline application materials before this date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NCRTC Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test or Computer Based Test carrying 80% weightage, followed by an Interview carrying 20% weightage.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid according to the official recruitment notification released by NCRTC.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official NCRTC website, download the filled application form, and send it by post along with necessary documents to the designated address.
